name: Declared Native Source Recheck (native-source-recheck)
description: C02/C10 recheck demo: the declared `native-source-recheck` route runs `native-bundle recheck-source` as one attempt — `source_recheck: rechecked` plus discharged `file_identity`/`claim_truth` on a clean run; a mismatched build-id pin claims no outcome.

intro: Step 2: Recheck the declared source fields.
Step 3: Try a mismatched build ID.
narrative.before: The declared route boundary has not yet been checked.
narrative.after: Only the route's declared fields are checked; broader guarantees are not claimed.
narrative.moment: Source pin is rechecked; wrong build ID selects nothing.

result_message: Result: Source recheck only; wrong ID selects nothing.

intent_fidelity.source_intent: C02/C10 recheck demo: the declared `native-source-recheck` route runs `native-bundle recheck-source` as one attempt — `source_recheck: rechecked` plus discharged `file_identity`/`claim_truth` on a clean run; a mismatched build-id pin claims no outcome.
success_criteria: report.json carries source_recheck == 'rechecked', discharged_checks == ['claim_truth','file_identity'] and a non-null selected_result
wrong_report.json carries no source_recheck, no selected_result and normalized exit_code 1

harness_contract.intent: Demonstrate the declared source-level bundle recheck: build a real native bundle, run `python -m agent native-source-recheck` so the pinned identities and source postcondition are freshly rechecked within the profile, then show a mismatched expected-build-id produces no claimed outcome.
artifact_contracts: Read inputs: scenarios/native_source_recheck/src/main.mm and the freshly built bundle/ plus its pinned build-id.
Step 2 runs `native-source-recheck` and asserts source_recheck == rechecked with discharged file_identity + claim_truth.
Step 3 a mismatched expected-build-id produces no claimed outcome.

steps.name: Build a real native bundle
steps.command: {mumei_bin} native-bundle build {root_dir}/scenarios/native_source_recheck/src/main.mm -o {output_dir}/bundle > {output_dir}/build.log 2>&1 && python3 -c "import hashlib; print(hashlib.sha256(open('{output_dir}/bundle/native-bundle.json','rb').read()).hexdigest())" > {output_dir}/build_id.txt; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/build.log; cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt; test $rc -eq 0
steps.artifact_contract: bundle/ holds the native bundle; build_id.txt pins the record sha256.
steps.verifier_gate: native-bundle build exits 0 with a bundle directory.

steps.name: native-source-recheck reports rechecked + discharged checks
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-source-recheck --core {mumei_bin} --bundle {output_dir}/bundle --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_source_recheck/src/main.mm --expected-build-id $(cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt) --output {output_dir}/report.json > {output_dir}/recheck.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/report.json; cat {output_dir}/recheck.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/report.json')); assert r['source_recheck']=='rechecked', r; assert r['discharged_checks']==['claim_truth','file_identity'], r; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is not None, r; print('native-source-recheck: rechecked, selection bound')"
steps.artifact_contract: report.json holds source_recheck rechecked, the discharged-check partition and a bound selection.
steps.verifier_gate: native-source-recheck exits 0; the source is freshly rechecked within the profile.

steps.name: Mismatched expected-build-id claims no outcome
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-source-recheck --core {mumei_bin} --bundle {output_dir}/bundle --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_source_recheck/src/main.mm --expected-build-id $(python3 -c "import hashlib;print(hashlib.sha256(b'not-the-build-id').hexdigest())") --output {output_dir}/wrong_report.json > {output_dir}/wrong.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/wrong_report.json; cat {output_dir}/wrong.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/wrong_report.json')); assert 'source_recheck' not in r; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is None; assert r['normalized'].get('exit_code') == 1, r['normalized']; print('mismatched build id: no claimed outcome')"
steps.artifact_contract: wrong_report.json holds no source_recheck, no selected_result and normalized exit_code 1.
steps.verifier_gate: The mismatched pin exits 1 — no claimed outcome.
